Title: Signal K Gateway Kit
Body (HTML):
DIY Signal K / NMEA 2000 gateway kit built around the Hat Labs SH-ESP32.

Ships from the USA.

Kit includes

  • 1× SH-ESP32 development board (sales package)
  • 1× Waterproof enclosure 100×68×50 mm (flanges + holes)
  • 1× NMEA 2000 Micro-C panel connector with pigtails

What this is

A developer-style installation kit for boaters building a Wi-Fi / USB NMEA 2000 gateway or custom Signal K sensor node. Firmware and install guidance are provided by Nautic Controls (board does not ship with finished consumer gateway firmware from Hat Labs).

DIY note

This is not a drop-in Actisense or Yacht Devices finished gateway. Expect basic soldering/assembly skill and firmware flashing.

Hardware by Hat Labs Oy. Docs: docs.hatlabs.fi

Title: SH-ESP32 Development Board
Body (HTML):
Hat Labs SH-ESP32 sensor development board for marine and automotive systems. Isolated NMEA 2000 CAN, protected I/O, 8–32 V power, Wi-Fi / Bluetooth via ESP32.

US stock via Nautic Controls (Florida). Faster domestic shipping than ordering from Finland.

Typical uses

  • NMEA 2000 / NMEA 0183 gateways
  • Tank, bilge, temp, RPM, and attitude sensors
  • Relay control (lights, blowers, winch)
  • Custom Signal K nodes with SensESP

Sales package

  • SH-ESP32 rev.2 with connectors soldered
  • Pluggable screw terminals (CAN + power)

Programmable over micro-USB. Recommended framework: SensESP. Docs: docs.hatlabs.fi

Developer board — firmware not pre-installed.

Title: SH-RPi Sailor Hat for Raspberry Pi
Body (HTML):
Hat Labs SH-RPi (Sailor Hat) power-management HAT for Raspberry Pi. Wide 9–32 V input, supercapacitor safe shutdown, current limiting, monitoring, and RTC.

US stock via Nautic Controls. Raspberry Pi not included.

Highlights

  • Three 20F supercapacitors for controlled shutdown on power loss
  • Input current limiting (0.8 / 1.8 / 2.8 A)
  • Peak current up to 5 A; continuous 5 V output ≥ 3 A
  • HTTP API monitoring (voltage, current, temp)
  • Standard Pi HAT form factor; stackable with interface HATs

Note: any N2K port on related kits may be power-only depending on configuration — see Hat Labs docs. Docs: docs.hatlabs.fi/sh-rpi
